A unital cup-tail factor contains q; f commutes with that factor.

g.text: Exact scope — BFQ.4 and the second local form
Constant-multiplicity Følner input fails even with a freely chosen core.
Variable integer multiplicities and the first local form remain valid.
The bare second local form allows a more general tail projection s₀.
It does not include the cup-factor profile identity as a hypothesis.
